title: The Knight Cuts f8
setup: Your knight on d7 quietly covers f8, which leaves the black king far fewer squares than it thinks.
hint: Count the black king's escape squares before you check. Which of them is your knight already watching?
explanation:
## The Idea

The knight on **d7** covers f8, so a check on the a2–g8 diagonal leaves the king one square. {{Qe6+}} forces {{Kh8}}, and {{Qe8#}} mates on the back rank: the queen covers g8 and the pawns on g7 and h7 do the rest.
